beats.sub: Some shows ring a bell before every ad break. MinusPod can listen for it.

beats.head: Find the cue on an episode.
beats.sub: One scan surfaces sounds that repeat within the episode and counts how many sit at known ad breaks. Make a template from one.

beats.head: Templates live on the feed.
beats.sub: Intro, outro and ad-break cues, with a last-match date and health stats across processed episodes.

beats.head: Or scan several episodes at once.
beats.sub: Candidates that recur across the episodes you pick, with a count of how many share each.

beats.head: Cuts snap to the cue.
beats.sub: A Cue snapped badge marks each edge the cue sharpened. Confirm or reject matches to tune the feed.

beats.head: Tune it globally or per feed.
beats.sub: Global detection knobs, per-feed threshold and snap overrides. Cue-only mode skips the detection model on shows that always chime.

beats.head: Audio cues
beats.sub: Mark it once. Matching episodes after it snap their cuts to the chime.
